summary.text: Dave Sokola represents the 8th District in the Delaware Senate, which includes Newark, Pike Creek and North Star; he was first elected in 1990.

paragraphs.text: His Senate colleagues first chose him as President Pro Tempore in 2021.

He graduated from Mount Pleasant High School, earned a bachelor's degree in physical education from the University of Delaware, and worked 34 years as a lab technician at the DuPont Experimental Station before retiring in 2015.
